description: This file defines the SugarTheme class, a utility class used to manage themes within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM ecosystem. It provides methods for retrieving theme assets (CSS, JS, images, templates), managing caches, sprite handling, and theme configuration. The class also handles theme inheritance and customization features.

classes.name: SugarTheme
classes.description: A utility class providing theme management capabilities, asset retrieval, cache management, and sprite handling within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM theme system.
